blocks.orig: Located in northern Serengeti, Kenzan Migration Camp is a mobile camp that follows the Great Migration and offers 10 tents set near the Mara River in the Kogatende area. From July to October, when the Great Migration reaches the northern Serengeti, the camp is ideally positioned for watching river crossings and spotting wildlife such as lions and leopards. Meals are served in the dining tent, with bush dinners and breakfasts prepared on site. Each tent includes a bed, a seating area, and an ensuite bathroom. The camp is simple yet comfortable, with the views and sounds of the surrounding wilderness.
blocks.html: Following the Great Migration, Kenzan Migration Camp is a mobile camp in the north of the Serengeti, with 10 tents close to the Mara River in the Kogatende area. Between July and October, when the herds arrive in the northern Serengeti, its position is ideal for seeing river crossings and for spotting animals such as lions and leopards. Meals are taken in the dining tent, and the team prepares bush breakfasts and dinners right on site. Each tent has an ensuite bathroom, a bed and a place to sit. It is a simple, comfortable camp, with the wilderness around you to see and hear.
